limits: Synthetic local stream CPU/wall timing only; no provider or account/network requests.
Normalization changes only documented generated protocol timestamp fields; tool arguments, opaque blocks, signatures, native framing and accounting are retained.
Small/byte-fragment controls are noisy and some medians increase; no universal latency multiplier or whole-router claim.
Heap growth before garbage collection is reported but is not a retained-memory bound.
